title: POST /api/payment/request has no order-status guard — a payment link can be minted for an already-paid/cancelled order
suggested_fix: Only allow payment initiation when order.status === 'pending_payment' (return 400 otherwise) before calling paymentRouter.requestPaymentWithFailover and before overwriting `authority`.

title: markOrderPaid double-credits VIP points under concurrent verify callbacks on PostgreSQL
suggested_fix: On PG (READ COMMITTED) two concurrent /verify callbacks can both read status='pending_payment' and both credit points. Make the transition atomic: UPDATE orders SET status='processing' WHERE id=? AND status='pending_payment' RETURNING, and only credit points when a row was returned (same pattern as the oversell fix in orders.ts).

title: User cancel: check-then-act status guard is not atomic — concurrent double-cancel double-restocks and double-refunds on PG
suggested_fix: Perform the status flip first with an atomic predicate: UPDATE orders SET status='cancelled' WHERE id=? AND status IN ('pending_payment','processing') RETURNING; if no row, abort. Then restock/refund once. Same defect exists in the cancel branch of PUT /api/admin/orders/:id/status (admin.ts:526-550).

title: Coupon usage cap is TOCTOU on PostgreSQL — concurrent orders can exceed usageLimit
suggested_fix: Apply the same atomic-predicate pattern used for stock: UPDATE coupons SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE code = ? AND (usage_limit IS NULL OR used_count < usage_limit) RETURNING code; if 0 rows, reject the coupon. The read-only check at line 154 is racy on PG.

title: Address CRUD functions close over stale `user` state — concurrent/repeated address mutations lose data
evidence: const addAddress = async (address) => { if (!user) return; ... setUser({ ...user, addresses: [...(user.addresses || []), data.address] }); } — same pattern in updateAddress (setUser({...user, addresses: user.addresses.map(...)})), deleteAddress and setDefaultAddress. All four spread the `user` captured at render time instead of using functional updates.
suggested_fix: Use functional updates: setUser(prev => prev ? { ...prev, addresses: [...] } : null) in all four address functions, so consecutive awaits (e.g. addAddress then setDefaultAddress) don't overwrite each other's result.

title: Guest-cart merge can silently drop guest items if a push fails, and is not aborted on logout
evidence: const pushGuest = guestItems.map(item => authFetch('/api/cart', {...}).catch(err => console.error('Failed to merge guest cart item', err))); Promise.all(pushGuest).then(() => authFetch('/api/cart', ...)).then(data => { if (Array.isArray(data)) { setCart(data); localStorage.setItem('cart', JSON.stringify(data)); } }) — a failed POST is swallowed, then the authoritative server list unconditionally REPLACES local state, destroying the guest item.
suggested_fix: Fail the merge (keep local state) when any push rejects, e.g. throw inside the catch so Promise.all rejects and the replace is skipped; or re-push failed items.

title: Header login modal has no role="dialog", no aria-modal, no focus trap, no Escape close
evidence: <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto"> — no role/aria-modal attributes anywhere in the file (grep shows only body-overflow effects at lines 29-41); focus is never moved into the modal nor trapped, so keyboard/SR users can tab into background content and Escape does not close it.
suggested_fix: Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label, autofocus the first field, trap Tab within the panel, close on Escape (CartDrawer.tsx and Blog.tsx already do this).

title: Refresh token accepted from JSON body, and both tokens returned in JSON response — HttpOnly cookie protection undermined
suggested_fix: Remove the `req.body.refreshToken` fallback and stop spreading `...tokens` into JSON responses (register/login/otp/verify/refresh all do this). Rely solely on the HttpOnly cookies; the client already uses cookie-based refresh via authFetch. Keeping tokens out of JS-readable responses makes XSS token exfiltration materially harder.

title: No refresh-token rotation state or revocation: logout/compromise cannot invalidate a live refresh token (7d TTL)
suggested_fix: Rotation reissues a fresh pair (good) but old refresh tokens stay valid until 7d expiry — /logout only clears cookies server-side and there is no token-version/jti denylist. Add a `tokenVersion` (or jti) column on users, embed it in the refresh JWT, check+increment on logout/password change/admin password reset (server/routes/admin.ts:289 sets a new password but any stolen refresh token still works).

title: 12 admin mutation endpoints have no Zod validate() middleware (hand-rolled, inconsistent checks)
evidence:
router.put('/users/:id/password', async (req, res) => { const { newPassword } = req.body; if (!newPassword || typeof newPassword !== 'string' || newPassword.length < 6) {...}
// also unvalidated: /users/:id/role (317), /users/:id/points (344), /products (372), /products/:id (404), /orders/:id/status (511), /coupons (593), /coupons/:code (635), /orders/:id/tracking (803), /reviews/:id/approved (841), /contact-messages/:id/status (717), /settings (935)
suggested_fix: Add Zod schemas in server/validators (adminPasswordSchema, roleSchema, pointsSchema, productUpsertSchema, orderStatusSchema, couponUpsertSchema, trackingSchema, approvedSchema, messageStatusSchema, settingsSchema) and pass to validate() like cart/orders/auth routes already do. Admin-only status lowers exploitability but parseInt()-coercion gaps (e.g. `parseInt(stockQuantity) || 0` silently zeroes stock on garbage input) are real logic bugs.

title: Stock/price changes never bust the `product:<id>` detail cache — invalidate('products') does not match 'product:<id>' keys
suggested_fix: 'products' is not a substring of 'product:5', so GET /api/products/:id keeps serving stale stockQuantity/price for up to 60s after an order, cancellation, or admin product edit. Invalidate('product:') (prefix) or call appCache.invalidate() with no pattern for product mutations.

title: PUT /api/cart/:id accepts any quantity — max-10 and stock guards are not enforced on update
suggested_fix: Validate 1 <= quantity <= 10 and quantity <= product.stockQuantity (as POST / does). Currently a client can set quantity=999999; the invariant is only rescued later by the order-transaction stock guard.

title: VIP clawback can drive vipPoints negative
suggested_fix: If an admin adjusted the user's points (PUT /api/admin/users/:id/points sets an absolute value) after the order was credited, the clawback subtracts from a balance that may not contain those points, producing a negative vip_points. Clamp with SQL: set vipPoints = MAX(0, vipPoints - X) or guard with vipPoints >= X.

title: Empty catch blocks silently swallow errors in the Bale bot
evidence: } catch {}
suggested_fix: At minimum log the swallowed error (console.warn with the method/context); silent catches hide broken notification/fallback paths.

title: No dedicated rate limiter on POST /api/orders, POST /api/payment/request, /api/auth/refresh — only the general 600/15min cap
suggested_fix: POST /api/payment/request hammers external bank gateways on each call and /api/auth/refresh is an unauthenticated token-oracle endpoint; give both a strict limiter (e.g. 10-20/min/IP), matching the authLimiter pattern.

title: PUT /api/users/me can take an already-registered phone — unique-constraint violation surfaces as a generic 500
suggested_fix: Pre-check `phone` uniqueness (or catch the constraint error and return 400 with a Persian message). A failed unique index currently yields a generic 500 and the profile update is silently lost.

title: addToCart computes newQty from stale `cart` closure — rapid double-clicks lose a quantity increment
evidence: const existing = cart.find(item => item.id === product.id); ... newQty = Math.min(existing.quantity + quantity, MAX_CART_QUANTITY); saveCart(cart.map(...)) — two synchronous clicks before re-render both read the same `cart`, so the second overwrites the first (qty +1 not +2).
suggested_fix: setCart(prev => ...) functional update and compute newQty inside it; sync to localStorage in an effect or inside the updater.

title: Product fetch has no cancellation/abort — fast navigation between products can render the wrong product
evidence: useEffect(() => { setLoading(true); fetch(`/api/products/${id}`)...then((data) => { setProduct(data); ... }) .catch(() => { setProduct(null); setLoading(false); }); }, [id]) — no `cancelled` flag or AbortController; a slow response for the previous id resolves last and overwrites the current product (also re-appends stale JSON-LD).
suggested_fix: Add `let cancelled = false;` + guard in then/catch with cleanup, or AbortController aborted in the effect cleanup (compare Offers.tsx which does this correctly).

title: Live-search fetch results not guarded against out-of-order responses
evidence: const timer = setTimeout(() => { fetch(`/api/products?search=...`).then(...setResults(data)...) }, 180); return () => clearTimeout(timer); — timer is cleaned up, but a slow in-flight fetch for an earlier query can resolve after a newer one and overwrite `results` with stale matches.
suggested_fix: Track the latest query in a ref (or use AbortController per effect run) and ignore responses whose query !== latest.

title: Toast removal setTimeout never cleared — state update after unmount / no cleanup on provider teardown
evidence: setTimeout(() => { setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id)); }, 3000); — fire-and-forget timer, not stored or cleared. Harmless for the app-root provider but each toast schedules an untracked timer.
suggested_fix: Store timer ids in a ref Map and clear on unmount; low impact since ToastProvider lives at root.

title: Bot-reply setTimeout not cleared on unmount — setState after unmount if widget closes/user navigates mid-'typing'
evidence: setIsTyping(true); setTimeout(() => { ... setMessages(prev => [...prev, botMsg]); setIsTyping(false); }, 800); — no timer ref/cleanup.
suggested_fix: Keep timer in a ref and clearTimeout in the component's unmount effect.

title: OTP countdown interval leaks on unmount and stacks when startCountdown is called twice
evidence: const startCountdown = (sec = 120) => { setOtpCountdown(sec); const interval = setInterval(() => { setOtpCountdown((prev) => { if (prev <= 1) { clearInterval(interval); return 0; } return prev - 1; }); }, 1000); }; — interval only self-clears via the updater; no cleanup return, and a second send-OTP creates a second concurrent interval.
suggested_fix: Hold the interval in a ref, clearInterval the previous one at the start of startCountdown, and clear it in a useEffect cleanup.

title: setTimeout(() => setAdded(false), 2000) not cleaned up on unmount (same in VipClubBanner.tsx:26, static/Blog.tsx:438)
evidence: addToCart(product); setAdded(true); ... setTimeout(() => setAdded(false), 2000); — a card unmounted within 2s of add-to-cart schedules a setState on a dead component.
suggested_fix: Clear the timeout in a useEffect cleanup (timer ref), or use a small useTimedFlag hook shared by these three sites.

title: App shell hardcodes dark canvas #090d16, drifting from --color-canvas-dark #0a1128
evidence: className="min-h-screen ... bg-[#f8fafc] dark:bg-[#090d16]" while index.css:58 defines --color-canvas-dark: #0a1128 (and index.css:131 paints body with var(--color-canvas-dark)). Additional drift: Header.tsx:81 dark:bg-[#080d15]/90, CartDrawer.tsx:69 dark:bg-[#0c1017], LatestReviews.tsx:81 dark:bg-[#0d121c] — four different near-black surfaces vs the token.
suggested_fix: Use bg-[var(--color-canvas-light)] dark:bg-[var(--color-canvas-dark)] in Layout and consolidate the Header/CartDrawer/LatestReviews hardcoded hexes onto the surface tokens.

title: Hardcoded text color dark:text-[#f7f8f8] duplicates --color-text-main-dark instead of referencing the token
evidence: className="... text-zinc-900 dark:text-[#f7f8f8] ..." (also Products.tsx:79,92) — #f7f8f8 is the literal value of --color-text-main-dark (index.css:78), copy-pasted rather than tokenized.
suggested_fix: Replace with dark:text-[var(--color-text-main-dark)] so a future palette change propagates.

title: User-visible cart-limit toasts render English digits (۹۹ shown as 99)
evidence: addToast(`حداکثر تعداد مجاز (${MAX_CART_QUANTITY} عدد) در سبد خرید قرار دارد`, 'warning'); and `حداکثر تعداد مجاز ${MAX_CART_QUANTITY} عدد می‌باشد` — MAX_CART_QUANTITY (constants.ts:13 = 99) is interpolated raw, unlike the rest of the UI which uses toPersianDigits.
suggested_fix: Wrap with toPersianDigits(MAX_CART_QUANTITY) — import from lib/utils like other components.

title: Server cart mutation responses ignored — local optimistic state can disagree with server (stock-limited qty)
evidence: await authFetch('/api/cart', { method: 'POST', ... body: JSON.stringify({ productId: product.id, quantity }) }); — response body is never read; the server clamps quantity to stock/max-10 (per API spec) but the local cart keeps the requested quantity, so checkout totals can diverge until the next full fetch.
suggested_fix: Reconcile from the POST/PUT response (or refetch cart) when the server-returned item differs from the optimistic one.

title: POST /api/contact and POST /api/contact/newsletter validated manually, not with shared Zod schemas
suggested_fix: Use validate(contactSchema)/validate(newsletterSchema) for consistency; also add an email format check to /api/contact (currently any non-empty string passes as email) and a dedicated contact rate limiter — only the general 600/15min limiter applies, so message-table flooding at ~40/min is possible.

title: CSP scriptSrc includes 'unsafe-inline' and imgSrc allows plain http:
evidence:
scriptSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
...
imgSrc: ["'self'", "data:", "https:", "http:"],
suggested_fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonce- or hash-based script policy (Vite bundles are external files; inline usage is small). Drop `http:` from imgSrc to avoid mixed-content loading of attacker-influenced product image URLs. Weakens XSS containment if an injection ever lands.

title: PUT /api/admin/users/:id/role returns the full DB row including the bcrypt password hash
suggested_fix: Destructure out `password` before responding (`const { password, ...safe } = updated`), matching the pattern used in GET /users (line 275-278). Admin-only, but the hash then sits in browser devtools/proxies/logs unnecessarily.

title: Unauthenticated GET /api/payment/verify lets the caller pick the verification provider via query param
evidence:
const explicitProvider = req.query.provider as any;
const verifyResult = await paymentRouter.verifyPayment({ authority, status, amountTomans: order.total, orderId: order.id }, explicitProvider);
suggested_fix: Verify against the provider recorded on the order (the one that issued the authority) instead of trusting `req.query.provider`; a caller could steer verification to a gateway where the authority/amount check differs. Low severity because amount+authority are still checked, but it removes a free parameter.

title: GET /api/admin/analytics loads every order+items, every user and every product into JS memory
suggested_fix: Category sales and top-selling products are expressible as SQL GROUP BY joins over order_items; the sales trend can filter orders to the 14-day window instead of scanning all history. Same full-table pattern remains in GET /api/admin/orders when page/limit are omitted (admin.ts:500-505).

title: Order creation inserts order items and updates stock one row at a time inside the transaction
suggested_fix: Batch-insert orderItems with a single tx.insert().values(items[]). Keep the per-item guarded UPDATE for the row-count oversell assert, but consider batching the inserts; minor latency win per order, matters most on PG round-trips.

title: Coupon validation response leaks internal usage data via raw row
suggested_fix: `coupon` is the raw DB row including usedCount/usageLimit/expiresAt internals. Return only {code,label,percent,amount,minTotal} plus computed discount/finalTotal.

title: Cart drawer has role=dialog/aria-modal but no focus management
evidence: <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="cart-drawer-title"> — Escape close exists (lines 22-31) but focus is neither moved into the drawer on open nor returned to the trigger on close, and Tab can escape into the page behind the modal.
suggested_fix: Focus the close button on open, implement a Tab cycle (or use <dialog>/inert on background), and restore focus to the opener on close.

title: Brand CTA orange (#F47C20) with white text is 2.7:1 — documented but still used widely on buttons/badges (AA fail for normal text on Obsidian/light canvases)
evidence: index.css comment: "primary-container #F47C20 = CTA fills (white text 2.7:1, large/bold only)" — yet bg-orange-500 text-white appears throughout (e.g. ProductFilterSidebar.tsx:192,192 'bg-orange-500 text-white', :265 'bg-orange-500 text-white border-orange-500') for small filter chips/labels, not only large/bold text.
suggested_fix: Use --color-primary-500 #d94e06 (4.16:1) or --color-primary-700 #994700 (6.12:1) for small white-on-orange text; reserve #F47C20 for large/bold or non-text elements.

title: Client filter cache never invalidated — stale prices/stock served all session after any admin change
evidence: const clientFilterCache = new Map<string, {...}>(); (module scope) ... clientFilterCache.set(cacheKey, { products: data, total: count, totalPages: pages }); — entries live for the whole SPA session; Compare.tsx explicitly refetches for this reason, but the Products page serves cached rows indefinitely.
suggested_fix: Add a TTL (e.g. 60s) or bust the cache on visibilitychange/focus.

title: Context value object recreated every render — all addToast consumers re-render on every toast add/remove
evidence: <ToastContext.Provider value={{ addToast }}> — a new object identity each render of ToastProvider; with ~35 files consuming toasts, each toast's 3s expiry re-renders every subscribed subtree (CartContext/AuthContext providers and their children are descendants).
suggested_fix: useMemo the value ({ addToast }) — addToast is already useCallback'd, so the memo makes the value stable and eliminates cascade re-renders.

title: JWT secrets only require 10 chars and are only blocklisted against 6 known placeholder strings
suggested_fix: Require min 32 chars and reject low-entropy secrets (e.g. entropy/length heuristic) rather than a fixed blocklist. Also assert JWT_ACCESS_SECRET !== JWT_REFRESH_SECRET (currently not checked — reusing one value for both silently passes validation). .env on disk contains all expected keys (PORT, DATABASE_URL, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID, ZARINPAL_SANDBOX, GEMINI_API_KEY, APP_URL, SMS_API_KEY, SMS_PROVIDER, SMS_TEMPLATE_ID, BALE_BOT_TOKEN, BALE_ADMIN_CHAT_IDS) — values not inspected.

title: Auth cookies lack __Host- prefix and explicit Domain scoping relies on default
evidence: res.append("Set-Cookie", `accessToken=${accessToken}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=${sameSite}; Max-Age=${accessMaxAge}${secure}`);
suggested_fix: Rename to `__Host-accessToken`/`__Host-refreshToken` (requires Secure, Path=/, no Domain — all already true in prod) to pin cookies against subdomain-injection. Flags themselves are correct (HttpOnly, Secure in prod, SameSite=Strict in prod / Lax in dev).

title: All limiters skipped only in test, but general limiter keying trusts a single proxy hop — consider keying login limiter by IP+phone
evidence:
const limiter = rateLimit({ windowMs: 15*60*1000, max: 600, skip: () => process.env.NODE_ENV === "test" || env.NODE_ENV === "test", ... });
app.set("trust proxy", 1);
suggested_fix: Distributed low-and-slow credential stuffing stays under 5 req/min/IP. Add a secondary per-account counter on /api/auth/login (keyGenerator including req.body.phone) so a botnet rotating IPs still gets throttled per victim phone number.

title: No test file covers /api/admin upload route
evidence: grep -rl upload tests/ -> only tests/unit/bale-bot.test.ts (unrelated); no tests/api/upload*.test.ts exists; ls tests/api shows 26 suites, none target upload.ts
suggested_fix: Add tests/api/upload.test.ts covering auth/admin gating, file-type and size validation, and rejection paths.

title: No test file targets the coupons-active route
evidence: grep -rl 'coupons-active' tests/ -> empty output; coupons.test.ts covers /api/coupons/validate and admin coupon CRUD but not coupons-active.ts
suggested_fix: Add a test for GET active-coupons listing (active/expiry filtering, no leaking of discountValue internals if public).

title: Blog API route has no direct API test
evidence: grep -rl blog tests/ -> tests/unit/blog-json-ld.test.ts, tests/api/sitemap.test.ts, tests/api/breadcrumbs.test.ts (JSON-LD/sitemap/breadcrumb only); no tests/api/blog.test.ts exercising blog.ts endpoints directly
suggested_fix: Add tests/api/blog.test.ts for blog list/detail endpoints (pagination, slug lookup, 404 path).

title: Fragile add-to-cart selector based on generic button+text filter
evidence: e2e/deep-coverage.spec.ts:68 uses page.locator('main button:not([disabled])').filter({ hasText: /افزودن به سبد خرید/ }).first(); ProductCard.tsx renders the text but no stable data-testid, so DOM-order changes (e.g. multiple cards) could pick the wrong button
suggested_fix: Add data-testid='add-to-cart' to ProductCard/ProductDetail buttons and target that in the spec.

title: Checkout submit located via partial aria-label match
evidence: e2e/deep-coverage.spec.ts:194 uses page.locator('[aria-label*="ثبت نهایی سفارش"]'); actual element is CheckoutOrderSummary.tsx:111 aria-label="ثبت نهایی سفارش و انتقال به درگاه پرداخت امن" — works today via substring match but is positional/linguistically fragile
suggested_fix: Add data-testid='checkout-submit' to CheckoutOrderSummary submit button and use it.

evidence: server/routes/upload.ts — no test file in tests/ (verified via grep -rl upload tests/)
